job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Developer with a strong foundation in backend development, APIs, databases, and full-stack technologies. This role goes beyond conventional development you'll be at the forefront of AI-driven applications, working with Agentic Workflows, LLMs, real-time communication tools, and automation systems.

This is a dynamic position that blends AI integration, cloud infrastructure, and modern web development, ideal for a candidate passionate about pushing the boundaries of intelligent software systems.

who have experience working on AI chatbots and/or AI voice agents The key skills we're looking for in these profiles include:




1) RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

2) Agentic Workflows

3) LangChain

4) Agentic Orchestration Frameworks

5) WebRTC

6) Speech-to-Text (STT)

7) Text-to-Speech (TTS)




Preferred Qualifications

4+ years of experience in Python development
Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
Proficiency in modern web development frameworks and UI libraries
Prior experience with LLM integration and prompt engineering
Familiarity with WebRTC protocols and real-time media streaming
Experience with automation tools for browser interaction
Understanding of software testing, debugging, and CI/CD best practices
Previous experience with data pipeline architectures and ETL processes
Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted development tools
Exposure to building voice-driven or conversational web apps

Nice to Have

Experience with LangChain, AutoGPT, or similar agentic orchestration frameworks
Familiarity with serverless architectures and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
Prior contributions to open-source AI or automation tools

If you are excited about this role please share your updated resume and contact details to connect with you to discuss further or contact us.
